Since February 14, 2018, it had 1 buying transaction, and 0 sales for $17.34 million activity.
Guru Ramakrishnan decreased its stake in T Mobile Us Inc (TMUS) by 50% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Meru Capital Group Lp sold 50,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.83% with the market. The hedge fund run by Guru Ramakrishnan held 50,000 shares of the public utilities company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $3.08 million, down from 100,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Meru Capital Group Lp who had been investing in T Mobile Us Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $53.23 billion market cap company. The stock increased 2.79% or $1.69 during the last trading session, reaching $62.3. About 1.48 million shares traded. T-Mobile US, Inc. (NYSE:TMUS) has risen 62.63% since March 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.93% the S&P500.
Meru Capital Group Lp, which manages about $798.95M and $32.97M US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 22,500 shares to 32,500 shares, valued at $5.01M in 2017Q3, according to the filing.
